annotation_scope: summary_plain only; date_string for lexical context; register labels only for identity candidates
slice: all regesta of RI_004-002-ReggBarbarossa.csv with start_date on or before 1153-12-31, in sorting order; 224 regesta, 218 new in batches 1-55 of four, six reused in batch 0

reused.note: These six regesta lie in the slice and were extracted, reviewed and corrected in runs/factoid-2026-11-11 under the same frozen contract. Their extracted and revised Turtle files are byte copies; their packets are byte-identical to that run's packets. They are not extracted, reviewed or corrected again here, and their prov:wasAttributedTo keeps the producers of that run.

stages.extraction: 55 Opus agents (model override opus, project default claude-opus-5-5), batches of four, each given the frozen prompts/extract.md, its packets and the contract; producer urn:regesta:agent:factoid-1153-2026-11-11:extraction-batch-N
stages.review: 22 Opus agents, two independent reviewers per group of twenty new regesta (eleven groups, the last of eighteen), each reading half the group without the extractors' batch reports, using prompts/review.md; review/review-gN-A.json and -B.json
stages.adjudication: 11 Opus agents, one per group, deciding each error, warning and change-proposing note against summary_plain and the contract; review/adjudication-gN.json
stages.correction: 11 Opus agents, one per group, applying only adjudicated corrections with prompts/correct.md; revised/corrections-gN.json merged into revised/corrections.json; uncorrected records copied unchanged

validation.validator: validate_factoid.py --self-test, unchanged; self-test passed in both stages
known_validator_limits: validate_factoid.py raises TypeError in _review_sheet on packet 22734, whose summary_plain is null in the delivery, after writing the stage JSON completely. Both German review sheets were written by a scratch wrapper that calls the unchanged _review_sheet with a placeholder for the null summary.

validate_factoid.py reads each record's status from the extraction batch reports only, so the revised stage reports a status mismatch for the four records whose outcome the correction changed (22669, 22671, 22736, 220532); revised/corrections.json holds the corrected status.
